home.playerNameHint: Shown in rankings and shared stages
story.lockedHint: Defeat the previous witch to challenge this one
book.defeatToUnlock: Win against her to record her profile and spell card
endless.desc: Stages are drawn at random until you lose. The more you clear, the faster your bonus grows.
battle.phaseEditSub: Drag the nodes to bend the paths
tutorial.drag: Drag a glowing node to bend the barrage path like a string. Each node can only move within its circle.
tutorial.collide: Bullets that collide cancel out, and the blast chains into nearby bullets. Blasts also damage the witch.
tutorial.defend: If a single bullet hits Crea or the barrier below, you lose. Clear every bullet to win.
tutorial.timer: When time runs out, the barrage fires. Fewer moves, more cancels and more hits mean a higher score!
share.blocked: The pop-up was blocked. Please check your browser settings.

replay.copyFailed: Could not copy. Please copy the shown text manually.
replay.importHint: Paste a replay code (starting with DWR1:). It will be verified before playback.
replay.mismatch: Replay verification failed (result does not match)
online.errNetwork: Network error. Please check your connection.
online.errInvalid: The data to send is invalid
editor.title: Stage Editor
editor.importFailed: Could not import the stage file (invalid format or content)
editor.lockedHint: Shared stages cannot be edited. Duplicate it to edit.
editor.hintPlace: Click an empty spot on the field to place a barrage
editor.hintDraw: Long-press a barrage and drag to draw its path; nodes are placed automatically
editor.hintSelect: Click a barrage to select, drag to move; drag white dots to fine-tune nodes
editor.registerOnce: Each creation can be shared once. It cannot be edited afterwards (you can duplicate it).
editor.needClear: Clear it in a test play to share
editor.full: You have reached the maximum number of stages
editor.tooLow: Too close to Crea to place a barrage
editor.strokeShort: The line is too short. Draw a bit longer.
settings.tutorialReset: The tutorial will show in the next battle
settings.clearConfirm: All progress, records, stages and settings will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

notice.fullscreenUnsupported: This browser does not support fullscreen
